backtest_protocol.execution_model: Signal uses only close-of-day OHLCV available on signal date. Paper entry is next available open with existing entry slippage; exit is the close 10 trading days after the signal with target-side sell slippage and ROUND_TRIP_COST_PCT.
backtest_protocol.source: docs/backtesting.md canonical three-window core replay plus replay-only broad warehouse default-off paper overlay

gate3.note: No new core filter or entry rule was added. The pressure resilience candidate source is additive default-off paper, so core signals generated/survived are unchanged from baseline.

gate_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: entry/candidate_pool: a tight signal-day range with a high close and elevated volume near a 20-day high may mark absorbed supply before continuation, while the non-breakout guard avoids simply retesting accepted compression breakout or rejected accumulation breakout.

2_history_check.exp-20260526-014: Volume-breadth breakout was accepted as market-breadth evidence; this run uses ticker-level range/volume absorption, not market breadth.
2_history_check.exp-20260528-015: Fundamental-growth RS low-volume support was accepted inside Companyfacts; this run tests a broad free-OHLCV structure because the Companyfacts overlay was recently too sparse.
2_history_check.exp-20260608-012/013: Compression-to-expansion was accepted; this run is not an expansion threshold retune because signal-day range must stay tight and distance-to-high cannot materially break out.
2_history_check.exp-20260608-016: Accumulation-base breakout was rejected because old_thin regressed and drawdown worsened; this run removes breakout chasing and tests quiet absorption only.

gate_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Use docs/backtesting.md three canonical windows. Accept only if aggregate EV/PnL improve, no EV/PnL regression window, target sample >=20 across all 3 windows, survival >=5%, drawdown drift <=0.5pp, and concentration guard passes.

hypothesis: Quiet high-close accumulation days with unusually tight signal-day range and elevated volume may identify absorbed supply in liquid uptrend stocks without chasing signal-day breakouts.
interpretation: The quiet tight-range accumulation source did not clear Gate 4. Do not promote or locally retune this OHLCV quiet-absorption family on the frozen windows.
negative_reflection: If rejected, the likely reason is that tight high-close volume absorption is too close to generic low-volatility momentum, selects too many stale consolidation days, or does not contain enough catalyst pressure to beat next-open costs. Do not answer by sweeping range, volume, distance-to-high, ret5/ret20, hold-day, cooldown, or notional thresholds on these frozen windows.
next_evidence_needed: A retry needs materially new evidence such as forward replacement-value rows, same-day production-visible catalyst provenance, or a PIT flow/ownership field. Pure OHLCV quiet-range threshold retunes should stay frozen.

post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retry by sweeping signal range, range-to-median ratio, volume ratio, close-location, distance-to-high, ret5/ret20, top-N, hold-day, cooldown, or paper notional thresholds on these frozen windows.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: Next useful evidence is forward replacement-value rows, a shared default-off helper that reproduces this exact replay and daily snapshot semantics, or an orthogonal PIT catalyst/flow field. Live activation would need a separate activation-envelope Gate 1-4.
post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The fixed quiet-range absorption source failed Gate 4 because the tight high-close volume field did not add robust replacement value across the canonical windows after next-open execution and cooldown. The likely mechanism is stale consolidation or broad low-volatility momentum relabeling without enough catalyst pressure.

prediction.confidence_reason: Accepted compression and volume-breadth edges suggest OHLCV absorption can work, but recent accumulation breakout failed old_thin and the accepted low-volume support lead was Companyfacts-bound. This fixed policy tests quiet signal-day absorption, not breakout retuning.

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result would require a shared default-off adapter that computes the same sector-known liquid stock universe, signal-day tight-range field, high-close absorption field, elevated-volume field, near-20-day-high non-breakout guard, SPY-relative trend guards, same-ticker core-overlap exclusion, next-open paper entry, 10-trading-day exit, costs, cooldown, and concentration controls in both historical replay and daily production before any report queue, paper ledger, candidate priority, sizing, watchlist, or order surface could change.
